Pipeline.//MaxConcurrentJobs: Videos rendered at once. 1 = serial (safe). Raising to 2 needs ~4-5GB free RAM (each render is ~1.5-2GB headless Chrome), else it OOM-crashes.
Pipeline.//BeatGapMs: Measured on @YosherYaps: narration is wall-to-wall, first word at 0.0s, last word within 0.5s of the end. Gaps between beats read as dead air.
Pipeline.//OutroMs: His closing comment is READ ALOUD and the video cuts almost immediately after. A long silent outro card is a scroll-away.

Tts.//ForceEmotion: Overrides every beat's emotion for constant energy (ElevenLabs v3). Try: excited | shouting | screaming. Empty = per-beat swing.
Tts.//ElevenLabsSpeed: MEASURED: eleven_v3 IGNORES this (speed unset = 8.8s, speed 1.1 = 9.0s on the same line). Use ElevenLabsSpeechRate instead - it works on every model. PITCH remains the real voice gap (ours ~163Hz median vs reference 240Hz); only a different ElevenLabsVoiceId fixes that.
Tts.//ElevenLabsTrimSilence: Strips ElevenLabs' per-clip padding. MEASURED: cut the trailing dead air from 1.50s to 0.97s and lifted effective rate from 121 to ~179 WPM on its own.
Tts.//ElevenLabsSpeechRate: ffmpeg atempo, applied before duration is measured. MEASURED: 1.0+trim = ~179 WPM; 1.35+trim overshot badly to 242 WPM (reference is ~190). 1.05 is the computed value for ~190 - verify on the next render and adjust.

//Performance: Feeds YOUR channel's real view counts back into topic generation, so new topics copy what actually broke out. Public data via yt-dlp Ã¢â‚¬â€ no extra OAuth scope.
//Facebook: Page Reels via the Meta Graph API. Put PageAccessToken in .env (FACEBOOK__PAGEACCESSTOKEN), not here. Facebook schedules server-side, like YouTube.
//Instagram: Reels via the Graph Content Publishing API. Needs an IG Business/Creator account linked to the Page. IG cannot schedule, so the app publishes at the slot itself Ã¢â‚¬â€ it must be running then.

Remotion.//Concurrency: Peak memory is mostly parallel Chrome tabs + the compositor decoding bg.mp4 frames. 4 OOM-crashed the compositor on a 16GB box with ~5GB free; retries now halve this automatically (3 -> 1).
Remotion.//MaxAttempts: 3 so the concurrency backoff has room to reach 1 before giving up.
Remotion.//OffthreadVideoCacheMb: Bounds the decoded-frame cache (unbounded = compositor OOM). 512 was tight enough to thrash against long GOPs; the background clip now has a keyframe every 0.5s, and 1024 leaves headroom on a 16GB box.
